name: 风云三
group_note: Archive named 风云三 but the actual in-game banner reads 铁血江湖 (unrelated content, just a filename mismatch). is_chinese() was already fixed to a CJK codepoint check in this archive, but check_legal_name()'s length bounds (strlen<4||>8) and its byte-stepping loop (i%2==0 gate, name[i..<0] tail-slice) were still the stale GBK byte-pair assumption underneath, silently rejecting every real Chinese name including the standard 2-char test name -- fixed the bounds to match the character-count the error message already claimed (2-6) and the loop to per-character slicing (§8.1). quit.lpc enforces a genuine 30-real-second post-login cooldown (game design, not a bug) -- needed a longer idle/filler-send budget in testing to observe it complete rather than just the immediate notify_fail rejection. Formatter's blind-spot-3 CJK-respacing check caught 6 genuine corruptions (5 ASCII-art zone map files plus one help-text file where the tokenizer lost sync) among ~20 total flags -- reverted all 6 rather than hand-repairing. Admin (fluffos/Mud@2026) seeded via real registration + adm/etc/wizlist.
